title: 1. A Hing Biakna
body:
Phuak: Sian
BPM: 62 
 TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Nang omna mun ah, ka hih bang kong zuan hi
Ka vekpi in siit neilo in, kong ki sung hi
Kam bek tawh hi kei, lasak ciang bek hi kei
Ngeina khat ciang tawh zong hi kei, a thuk zaw in

Pre-Chorus
Nang hong mu nuam sing
Hong tel zaw sem nuam sing
Na ang sung naitak, in hong pom aw
Leitung nate sang’n
Kong deih zaw hi Topa
Ni dang te sang’n, nang kong it zaw hi

Chorus
Ka lungsim, ka kha, ka pumpi
A vekpi’n na mai ah kong lui hi
Ki neih omlo, ka hih bang bang in
Kong bia hi
Ka lunggulh na teng suahkhia in
Lungsim tawng dong a en Pa tung ah
A hing biakna kong pia 
Ka hinna khempeuh tawh

title: 2. A Hoih Pasian
body:
Phuak: Sian
BPM: 132 
 TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Thuman Pasian kikhel ngeilo
Na itna lian genzawh hilo
Sangpen ah ki lamto
Nang bang Pasian om lo
Na vangliatna tel zawh hilo
Na kumpi gam ki ling ngeilo
Sihna’n hon len zolo
Leitung na zozo hi

Pre-Chorus
A tawntung Nang na hoih hi Topa
Min khempeuh lak pan lian pen Zeisu

Chorus
Van leh lei khempeuh in
Na min hong phat hi
Minam khempeuh’n, Nang hong bia uh hi
Na min thang hi, Nang na lian hi Topa
Vanglian na khut te in, na lianpi sem zo
Mailam hunte, Na khut sung om hi
A hoih Pasian Nang a ding nungta ing

Bridge
Leitung khempeuh Nang na uk hi
Ka hihna teng Nang kong pia hi
Ka lungsim khempeuh Nang bek kong it hi x4

title: 3. A Kicing Hehpihna
body:
Phuak: Kim Pau
Key: G (Male)
BPM: 68
TimeSig: 4/4

Chorus
Topa nong hehpihna
It baang lo, kei a ding
Kicing hi, bei hun neilo hi
Kikhel hun, nei ngeilo
Zing sim thak suak den hi
Nong hehpihna
Tehpih ding a dang omlo

Verse 1
Hatsat hun ciang, nong ompih den hi
Hong huh in, lam nong, lak den hi
Ka dah hun ciang, nong hehnem den hi
Kei a ding, ka lawm hoih pen nang na hi

Verse 2
Ka mailam hun, na khut sung om hi
Nang sung ah, lungmuang, in om ning
Hong nusia ngei lo, mawh in khial mah ta leng
A tawntung, nong ompih den hi

title: 4. A Kicing Thupha
body:
Phuak: Sian
Key: E (Female)
BPM: 70
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Itna tawh ki dim Pasian
Na thuman tawntung hi
Sim zawh loh ding nong piak, thupha ki cing
Na hehpihna hang bek tawh
Hih ciang nong tonpih hi
Na khut tawh kei nong len, kip tawntung hi
Lungdamna tawh, na min kong pahtawi hi

Chorus
Hong cing hong kem den Pasian
Na khempeuh ah na hoih hi
Na molhtum leh ciangkhut in
Ka lungmuanna
Ka muh ngei nai loh thupha
Ka zaak ngei nai loh thupha
Mite’n piang theih ding
A up zawh loh thupha
Kei nong piak thuah lai hi

Verse 2
Ka mai ah a pai Pasian
Nong makaih tawntung hi
Ka lampite, nong hon sak tawntung hi
Ka ngaihsutna kheng vaal in
Ka theih na sang hoih zaw
Na lian tampi, nong sepsak khin zo hi
Lungdamna tawh na min kong pahtawi hi

Bridge
Nang a ding a haksa
Na khat bek zong om kei
Seplah a nei lo Pasian
A piang theilo nate
A pian theih loh laitak
A piang sak thei ka Pasian

title: 5. A Lian Pen Itna
body:
Phuak: Thein Khai
Key: A (Female)
BPM: 134
TimeSig: 6/8

Verse 1
La in sa ning Topa Nong itna
Naubang Nong kem aa
Nong nusia ngei kei hi
Abeisa ka hun leh mailam zong
Topa nang khut sung
A vekpi in om hi

Pre-Chorus
Leimi mawhna hang
Gimthuak in singkhuam tung ah
Na nunna pia in kei nong tan zo
Lungkham haksatna
Lungdamna tawh nong hei sak
Ka nunna sun nibang Nong tan hi

Chorus
Phat phat ning ka hu tawp dong in
Nong itna thute sut sut ning
It bang lo kei lel Nong it a
Na sisan tawh Nong tan
Nong gupna thute gen khia ning
Zeisu ka neih man nuam lua ing
Tul ngeilo Nong hehpihna
A lianpen itna tawh kei nong it hi

title: 6. A Nisim In
body:
Phuak: Kim Pau
Key: E (Male)
BPM: 150
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
A nisim in Topa itna
A nisim in Topa hoihna
A nisim in Topa hehpihna
Kicing den hi

Verse 2
A nisim in a thumaan na
A nisim in a kamciam na
A nisim in hong piak thupha te
Kicing den hi

Pre-Chorus
Huihpi tuihualte a daisak thei Topa
A tawntung in ei tawh
Hong om khawm den hi

Chorus
Zekai cih om ngei lo
Laplah cih om ngei lo
Hong len den, vanglian a khut tawh
Hong nusia ngei lo hi
Hong taisan ngei lo hi
Hong manghilh ngei lo hi
Nisim in

title: 7. A Piang Theilo Omlo Hi
body:
Phuak: Joth Hung (Nothing Is Impossible)
Key: C (Male)
BPM: 142
TimeSig: 4/4

Chorus
Nang hang’n, na khempeuh hih thei ingh
Na khempeuh hih thei ingh
Hong thahat sak na hih man
A piang theilo omlo hi
Nang hang’n, mittaw ten khua mu zo
Khuukpi teng kisia zo
Upna tawh nungta ingh
A piang theilo omlo hi

Verse 1
Ka muhna bek tawh nung ta kei ning
Ka theihna ciang bek tawh nungta kei ning
Ka sungah, ka thei nong ompih hi
Na khempeuh, na hih theih ka thei hi

Bridge
Ka um hi, ka um hi
Ka um hi, ka um hi, nang sung
Ka um hi, ka um hi
Ka um hi, ka um hi, nang sung

title: 8. Agape Itna
body:
Phuak: David Kham
Key: D (Female)
BPM: 70
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Leitung mit toh mel ka muh loh hang 
Vanglianpa khut in paibang hong pom den 
Naubang hong kepnate
Ham bang hong huai nate 
A nop in nuam semsem Halleluiah

Verse 2
Leitung pilna bang mah nei loh hang
Lung mawl keibang lel mimchi bang nong tel
Sian aw na leng gah huan
Gia bang zuun kacim lo
Laukha siangtho tuibang hong dim den aw

Chorus
Tung solkhapi a mial zong 
Tung sunni mual a liam zong 
Mual liam theilo kei nong itna
Cinglo taklo tual niam ka nunna 
A sanna lam hong kaito
Agape itna Pasian
Na min pak bang hong tawi na’n 
Zaila’n nau bang hong awi awi ning maw

Verse 3
Patpuan hilo, naipuan hilo a
Zeisu sisan toh kizem puan silh tang 
Lung in ka gel gel ciang
Hoih in a hoih sem sem 
Anbang nong itna lian tumdang diak sa’ng

Verse 4
Na hehpihna toh hih ciang kong tung 
Mailam ka nunna hong zang toto aw 
Lumbang hong sung den aw
Abraham bang in
Mite ading thupha hong hi sak aw

title: 9. Amah Muan Ding
body:
Phuak: T. Pumkhothang
Key: E (Female)
BPM: 60
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Lungkhamna te’n, a hon tuam chiang’n
Kipahnate, a hong bei chiang’n
Ka zuih siam hilou tuanglam ka zuih lai in
Ka Toupa in, a hon sinsak hi zaw

Verse 1 Repeat
Lungkhamna te’n, a hon tuam chiang’n
Kipahnate, a hong bei chiang’n
Ka zuih siam hilou tuanglam ka zuih lai in
Ka Toupa in, a hon sinsak hi zaw

Chorus
Hon pinate ka gel chiang in
Keimah lemgel in theihsiam, a haksa ngei
Hizong kei a di’n A vualzawlna leh
Amah muan ding, hon sinsak ahi zaw

Verse 2
Kaan zohlouh a, ka ngaihsutte
Pal zohlouh a, ka ngaihsutte
A muanhuainate ka muhna ding hi zaw
Amah a di’n, a haksa omlou e

Verse 3
Vuui takmai a, ka om in zaw
Aw a pialpak, a lang theilou
Tua in aw ka lam-etna a bahsak a
Hizong Aman, a pialpak hon musak

Verse 4
Koimun peuh ah ka om zong in
Hon pina khut, a muanhuai hi
Keimah hatna zaw muan ding, a omlou e
Amah hatna, a muanhuai pen hi zaw

title: 10. Amah Muanhuai
body:
Phuak: Sanboih
Key: F (Female)
BPM: 197
TimeSig: 6/8

Verse 1
Hih nuai simlei ah
Haksatna tuamtuamte ka thuak in
Belh ding simlei tung ah muh loh zong
Buai dek nawn keng

Chorus
Amah’n ka kidalna lum
Amah’n ka minthanna zong
Amah ka lu hong phong Pa
Hong kemden Pa
Aw Zeisu, Amah muanhuai

Verse 2
Hih nuai simlei ah
Ze-etna tuamtuamte ka nawk in
Lungkiat thanem hun om zel mah leh
Lau dek nawn keng

Bridge
Gualzawhna pen Zeisu
Nang a hi
Gualzawhna pen Zeisu
Nang hang hi

title: 11. Atawntung Itna
body:
Phuak: Lian Lam Tuang
Key: A (Female)
BPM: 65
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Simlei ka nuntakna sung ah
Nang tawh lo in
Bang ci kalsuan ding maw
Bang ci mainawt ding maw, Topa
Sih theih nat theih lauhuaina tampi om

Verse 2
Nisim ka nuntakna sung ah
Nang sung lo in
Lailung muanna om kei
Libang cinna om kei, Topa
Haksat buaina lunggimna tampi om

Pre-Chorus
Khatvei ka nunnna, khim bang zing
Sihna guam thuk lua ka tawt zel hang
Nong itna khut in
Kei nong ompih den lam thei ing

Chorus
[Hih simlei ka nuntak sung
Bang bang piang bang thu bang la piang zong
Lungmuang khamuang in kei nong ompih den
Thusia, lasia, lungkham, mangbatnate pan in] x2
Kei nong ompih, a tawntung
Kei nong ompih, a tawntung in

title: 12. Aw A Lamdang E
body:
Phuak: T. Pumkhothang
Key: E (Female)
BPM: 70
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Hatlo mi ka hi zong, hattheihna thugukte 
Topa in kei a dingin a nei 
Khovel in a telloh, khovel in a deihloh
Topa in Amah dingin a tel

Chorus 1
Aw a lamdang e, aw a thupi e 
Na itna, aw na hehpihna     
Mi mawlte na ngawn zong 
Aw na tel lawmlawm 
Lamdangin aw a thupi e

Verse 2
Lelliangte na it a, gentheite na huai a 
Leitung mi’n a phawk zawhlohte zong 
Topa aw na thei a, itna in napi zel 
Gentheihna pan in nunnopna ah

Verse 3
Lamet bei a lung ngai, mi poite na thei a 
Piangsualte bukimlote na ngawn 
Khovel hoihna mulo, mitdelte na thei a 
Nang a ding na telta, lamdang e

Verse 4
A chinglo a omlo, a siamlo a omlo
Mi khempeuh i Topa mai ah zaw 
Leitung mi ading a simmohhuai a neute 
Silpak bang a lun Topa adding

Chorus 2
Aw a lamdang e, aw a hon telna
Kipak in nuamna lasa ni
Khovel in a phawkloh
Mi ihi zong in
A hontel na a lamdang e

title: 13. Aw Nem
body:
Phuak: CK Khai
Key: F (Male)
BPM: 55
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Hun leh nite, pian ki dang in
Leitung nate kisia in
Van leh lei a mangthang zong
Bei hun neilo, mong neilo in a kip tawntung
Sihna pan hong suakta sak
Topa aw Nang kei nong itna hi

Chorus
Zeisu aw ken hong it lua ing
Miten kei hong pampaih zong
Nang kei nong pom den hi
Na thu manglo in kong taisan hang
Nunghei in nong delh kik hi
Itna aw nem tawh nata kei nong sam in
Thupha nong pia hi

Verse 3
Ka pillohna, ka siamloh na
Ka khialhna tampi takte
Itna tawh nong maisak hi
Hoih loh pi mah, siamlo pi mah cinglo pi mah
Tualniam pen kei nong phawk se
Topa aw, nong itna lamdang hi

title: 14. Aw Zeisu Amen Hong Paita In
body:
Phuak: C. Saikhuma
Key: F (Female)
BPM: 132
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Zeisu hong paikik nang, ciaptehna khempeuh leh
Pasian kamsangte genkholh te tung zo
Ih Topa Zeisu in, ama vangliatna tawh
Mi siangthote manlang in hong khawm ding

Chorus
Aw Zeisu, Amen hong pai ta in
A gimte khawlna hun hong tung ta hen
Ngak lah ing, Amen hong paita in
It leh ngaih teng ki muhkikna ding hun

Verse 2
Van ah ciaptehna te, hong tung kim khin zo ta
Ni mial, kha mial, aksi te hong kia hi
Sangpen Topa mai ah, lei leh van beimang zo
Topa hong pai ding hun hong naita hi

Verse 3
Leitung hunsia khinzo, siatna hong khang sem ta
Kidona awging tampi kiza hi
Gitlohna hong khang in, huaiham angsung genna
Topa hong pai ding hun hong nai ta hi

Verse 4
Hi gam lungdamna thu, leitung mun khempeuh ah
Gen khit mateng bei na hong pianglo ding
Ki pum piak na nei in, deihsakna tawh sem ni
Hehpihna kong khak ma in zo meng ni

title: 15  Bangmah Kisam Nawnlo
body:
Phuak: Thang Tawng
Key: G (Male)
BPM: 100
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Topa sungah, apiang theilo bangmah om kei
Hih theihna khempeuh, a dimlet hi
Vangliatna tawh, a kidim To Zeisu in
Na khempeuh, apiang nang, semthei hi

Chorus
Bangmah kisam nawn lo
Bangmah kisam nawn lo
Zeisu om leh, kicing hi
Bangmah kisam nawn lo
Bangmah kisam nawn lo
Zeisu om leh, piang thei hi
Na khempeuh piang thei hi

title: 16. Ebenezer
body:
Phuak: David Kham
Key: E (Female)
BPM: 82
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Anglai ah ka pom, aman kei hong len 
Vanglianpa’n hongkem, zani tuni a tawntung 
Topa in zingvai bang hawm a
Topa ka khuavak hong hi ta

Verse 2
Sambang zalna peuh, van laukha’n hongkem 
Lungkham huihkhi leh, tuihualte hong daisak hi 
Tu ciang ciang gualzawhna hongpia 
Gualzawhna mualsuang bang phut ing

Chorus
Topa na min kong pahtawi hi 
Nang bang adang Pasian omlo
Na hoihnate sinlung ka gelciang 
Lungdam luankhite’n Nang hong phatzel

title: 17. Emmanuel Pasian
body:
Phuak: Mung Pi (GZI)
Key: G (Female)
BPM: 66
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Sim leitung i nunna ah
Haksatna ten hong nawk ciang
Lau ken ka ta aw cin
Nang kong ompih den ci

Verse 2
Lono na ah hong lumsak
Tuidam kiang ah hong pai pih
Tucing pan hong tonpih
Nang kong ompih den ci

Chorus
A angsung hong pom den a
A kha nuai ah hong kem hi
Simleitung haksat buaina te zong
Khat khit khat hong zawhpih lai ding
Hong taisan ngeilo ding a
Hong nusia ngeilo itna
Sihna lim guamthuk pi sung nangawn
Na nawk hang kong ompih ding ci

Verse 3
Ni leh kha aksi khempeuh
Vut leh vai a suak khin zong
Emmanuel Pasian in
Ei hong ompih den ci

title: 18. Galhang Zeisu
body:
Phuak: Phillip Piang
Key: B (Male)
BPM: 102
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Khua hun ki khel in, huih nunzia ki dang zong
Nong itna kip in ki khel ngei kei
Mual te kiling in, van leh lei mang thang zong
Na kammal mangthang ngeilo ding
Mangthang ngeilo ding

Chorus
Ih lang hong pang galhiam kiplo ding
Khuamial thukpi
Ih nawk hang ih lau kei ding
Ei lam hong om Pa muanhuai hi
Guallel ngeilo hi

Bridge
Lau neilo, lelh neilo, a galhang Zeisu
Sihna tuancil in a gualzo Pa
A hangsan, a muan huai, a thahat Zeisu
Na khempeuh Nang a ding baih lua

title: 19. Gualzo Pasian
body:
Phuak: Sian
Key: B (Male)
BPM: 138
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Kumpi khempeuh te kumpi
To khempeuh te Topa hi
Min khempeuh te sang’n min lian pen
Khang tawntung ki liing ngeilo
Munkip suangpi

Pre-Chorus
Na vangliatna ki ciangtan lo
Ki khel ngeilo, kiam ngeilo hi
Na hehpihna bei ngeilo hi
Kei ading kicing den hi

Chorus
Ka kha hong gumkhia pa Nang na hi
Nuntakna Nong pia hi
Kei tang sihna Nong thuak hi
A hi zong’n sihna’n hong len zo lo
Gualzawhna lianpi tawh
Sihna pan Nong thokik hi
Nang na vaanglian hi, Topa
Na khempeuh tung thunei Pa
Na kumpi gam a tawntung kip hi
A maang tawntung Topa

Verse 2
Natna namkim damsak Pa
Misite a thosak Pa
Huihpi leh tuihual daisak Pa
Ka sung hong teeng den Pasian
Kikhel ngei lo

title: 20. Hampha Lua Ing
body:
Phuak: David Khualpu
Key: G (Female)
BPM: 65
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Kei mimawh ka nuntak na
Nong itna ka ngaihsut ciang
Hampha lua ing e, ka to Zeisu hangin
Amah na asem dingin
Ka nunna hong tel man in
Mi nasem hilo, Topa nasem ka hi
 
Leitung hamphatna tuam tuam
Ka et khak, ka khuadak ciang
Khat vei vei ciangin, ka tha nem khazel e
Na khempeuh apiang sakpa
A bawlpa ka neih a kipan
A hau pen ka hih lam ka kiphawk hi

Chorus
Hampha lua ing e
Hampha zen mah sing maw
Topa itna lian lua e, zailua sa’ng
Lungdam lua ing e
A nungta ka to Zeisu hangin
Mi hampha penpen tu’n, ka hi

Verse 2
Honpa Zeisu hotkhiatna
Theilo khuamialpi sungah
Mawhna sungah, siding ka om laitak
Tu-in honpa Zeisu hang
Suahtakna tu’n ka ngahzo
Hampha zensing maw
Nuam lawm lawm sing maw
Kei lel tak kanunna aw
Nak hamphat zen mah sing maw
Mi hizah lai ah, kei tang tel banglel tak
Ama hong theihkhak khakhih
Hong phawk khak ka hih se se
Nuam zen mah singmaw
Nuam lawm lawm sing maw

Bridge
Na nasem dingin
Nong teel manin, nuam lua ing
Na nasem dingin
Nong teel manin, hampha lua ing

Tag
Hampha zenmah singmaw, hampha zensing
Hampha zenmah singmaw, hampha lua ing

title: 21. Hehpihna Simloh
body:
Phuak: Sian
Key: E (Female)
BPM: 166
TimeSig: 6/8

Verse 1
Vanglian Pa pasian
Ka lungsim sung khia’n
Na mai nuai kong zuan
Kisak theih na suah khia’n
Ki niamkhiat na tawh kong zuan
Phatna lukhu te, ka ngah thupha te
Nang nong piaksa hi 
Na khempeuh na kiang pan in
Na hehpihna hang bek hi

Chorus
Phatna pahtawina, Nang a hi
Minthanna liatna, Nang a hi
Hauhna gualzawhna, Nang a hi
Thuneihna khempeuh, Nang a hi
Ka diktan theihna, Nang hang hi
Na sisan ka siantho na hi
Na tokhom phung kong zuat theihna
Kilawm lopi mah, nong sanna
Nong it na bek hi

Verse 2
Topa nang lo tawh
Kei bang mah hi keng
Khut guak hawmpi hing
Ka neih bang mah om kei
Na khutsung kong ki pia hi
Topa nang simloh, ka lunggulh
Ka kisap dang om nawn kei
Kei nong hehpihna simloh
Ki saktheihpih ding nei keng

Bridge
Ka nuntak theihna, Nang hang hi
Ka thahatna teng, Nang hang hi
Ka hihna khempeuh, Nang a ding
Kong kipia hi
Hih ciang hong tunpih, Nang na hi
Ka mailam hun zong, Nang a hi
Na khempeuh nong hehpih na hi
Nang kong bia hi

title: 22. Hehpihna Tawh Ki Dimlet
body:
Phuak: Thang Tawng
Key: C (Male)
BPM: 150
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Nang tawh kalsuan peuh leng
Na khempeuh baih lua
Lungnop suahtakna om
Nong ompihna sung ah

Pre-Chorus
Thumna tauna om nawn lo
Haksatna teng tui suak zo
Zeisu hang in

Chorus
Tualniamna pan nong lam to
Gualzo pen sang gualzo pen
A sang pen na ah hong tonpih Zeisu
Mun khempeuh na khempeuh ah
Hehpihna tawh ki dimlet

title: 23. Hiah Om Ing Hong Bia Ding
body:
Phuak: Tim Hughes
Key: C# (Male)
BPM: 67
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Khuavak na hi
Khuamial sung nong kumsuk hi
Ka mit khua nong mu sak hi
Lungsim sung pan
Hong bia sak a pha
Nungta khawm ding lametna

Chorus
Hiah om ing hong bia ding
Hih mun ah hong kun ing
Ka Topa na hihna gen ding in
A it huai bel pa na hi
A kilawm bel na hi
A lamdang bel na hi, kei a ding

Verse 2
Tawntung Kumpi
A sang bel ah ki lam to
Vantung ah minthang Topa
Ki niamkhiat in
Na bawl leitung nong pai in
Nong it man bang mah nei lo

Bridge x2
Tel zo kei ning, bangzah’n lian hiam
Ka mawhnate, singkhuam tung ah
Tel zo kei ning, bangzah’n lian hiam
Ka mawhnate, singkhuam tung ah

title: 24. Hon Pa Zeisu
body:
Phuak: Khual Pi
Key: E (Male)
BPM: 112
TimeSig: 4/4

Verse 1
Topa Pasian in hong ompih hi
Topa Pasian in hong tonpih hi
Kei leh nang a tawntung
Topa Pasian in hong makaih hi
Topa Pasian in hong nusia ngei lo
Kei leh nang a tawntung

Pre-Chorus
Ka paina khempeuh ah hong ompih den hi
A vangliatna tawh a tawntung hong tuam hi

Chorus
Vangliatna tawh na mang hi
Gualzawhna tawh na thokik hi
Sihna in len zolo, hankhuk ten dal zolo
